authority: This remediation authorizes exactly one production behavior fix exposed by remediation-v2 mutation-sensitive analysis. It is execution-authoritative over all prior iteration-007 contracts where it adds detail. Every replacement prepare receipt, execution spec, checkpoint metadata, execution receipt, validator, and test must bind all six contract file hashes.

confirmed_defect.observation: A direct call with directional membership counts [1,1,1,1] returned passed=true and reported the mutated populations instead of rejecting deviation from the authoritative prepare rows.

authorized_production_fix.scope: Add one fail-closed authoritative directional-membership validator and call it before any directional metric is read or gate is computed.

authoritative_derivation_from_prepare_ro.teacher_end_ordinals: All and only ppo_row_ordinals whose teacher_index equals end_index.
authoritative_derivation_from_prepare_ro.teacher_end_and_sampled_end_ordinals: All and only teacher-END rows whose sampled_index also equals end_index.
authoritative_derivation_from_prepare_ro.positive_normalized_teacher_and_sampled_: All and only teacher-and-sampled-END rows whose fixed_normalized_advantage_float32 is strictly greater than zero.
authoritative_derivation_from_prepare_ro.positive_raw_teacher_and_sampled_end_ord: All and only teacher-and-sampled-END rows whose raw_advantage_float64 is strictly greater than zero.
authoritative_derivation_from_prepare_ro.negative_target_ordinals: Exactly [158,260,547,812], inherited from the bound historical control contract.

validation_rules: Require the directional_memberships object to have exactly the five expected keys.
Require each membership to be a sorted duplicate-free list of non-boolean integers within [0,829].
Recompute all five authoritative lists from the immutable prepare rows and fixed negative controls before every evaluate_directional_gates call.
Require canonical-JSON exact equality between the supplied object and the recomputed object, including order, membership, and counts.
Reject with a deterministic ValueError before reading any metric row when any key, count, ordinal, order, duplicate, type, range, or derived population differs.
Return and use only the recomputed authoritative object for all 4/20/31/41/43 gate loops and summaries. Never use an unchecked caller-supplied list.
forbidden_changes: changing any END threshold, inequality, delta baseline, metric formula, terminal rule, row, advantage, action, reward, model, optimizer, or update schedule
hard-coding the 20,31,41,43 lists independently of the prepare rows
silently replacing a malformed supplied membership with the recomputed one
continuing gate evaluation after a membership mismatch

required_fix_tests: The confirmed [1,1,1,1] mutated-count case raises before reading metrics.
For each of the five membership lists, removing, adding, reordering, duplicating, changing type, or using an out-of-range ordinal raises.
Mutating a prepare-row teacher_index, sampled_index, normalized-advantage sign, or raw-advantage sign without changing the supplied memberships raises because recomputation differs.
The byte-exact prepare-v2 4/20/31/41/43 memberships pass the production validator.
After membership validation passes, every remediation-v2 production-path boundary and outsider-poison test directly exercises evaluate_directional_gates.

replacement_prepare.publication: Create exactly once with CREATE_NEW semantics only after the production fix, every remediation-v2 production-path test, every fix test, and all regressions pass. Preserve prepare v1 and v2 byte-exact.

stop_rule: After the single authorized production fix and all required tests pass, generate prepare v3 exactly once and stop for independent code and numerical-provenance audits before execution-spec authoring.
